description: ROAD CENTERLINES is a dataset listed in Prince George's County open data portal (data.princegeorgescountymd.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Prince George's County. This layer contains a geospatial representation of the center of the paved surface of a travel roadway for all public and some private streets in Prince George's County, Maryland. Attributes for the centerline contain street information, routing functionality, and class type. Coverage: Prince George's County, Maryland. The portal files it under the category Government. The table has 29 columns. The portal shows 2023-06-15 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-princegeorgescountymd-gov-portal.
